name: Reassign work when an agent budget pauses
description: When an agent hits its monthly budget (the guardrails emit agent.budget_exceeded exactly once per agent-month), its open tasks are handed off per the org's workforce policy: reassigned one step up the org chart to its manager (only if the manager's own guardrails allow more work) or unassigned for triage to re-route. Each task gets an explanatory comment; in-progress work rolls back to To do on unassign. The budget pause itself clears automatically at the month rollover.
